events.title: Major eruption begins
events.description: Continuous lava fountaining starts at 23:07 WIB. Eruption tremor lasts six hours (amplitude 70 mm), the strongest activity of 2026.

events.title: VAAC: ash to FL450 (13.7 km)
events.description: Darwin VAAC advisory 2026/164 reports a high-level eruption. Ten minutes later ash reaches FL480, moving west at 93 km/h.

events.title: Plume reaches ~15 km
events.description: JMA and Darwin VAAC estimate the ash column at 15 km (50,000 ft). A lower layer to about 5.5 km drifts south.

events.title: Two ash layers
events.description: VAAC 2026/171: ash to FL500 moving west at 40 kt; a separate layer to FL200 moving south to east-southeast at 10 kt.

events.title: VONA RED issued
events.description: PVMBG raises the aviation colour code to RED (MAGMA notice 22575).

events.title: Ashfall in Lampung
events.description: From Saturday afternoon into the night, residents of Bandar Lampung, Lampung Selatan, Pesawaran, Pringsewu, Tanggamus and Pesisir Barat find ash on vehicles and terraces.

events.title: Ashfall on the Serang coast
events.description: From 17:00 WIB dust settles in Kampung Pasauran, Cinangka. Motorcyclists report stinging eyes; a school reports disrupted attendance.

events.title: VAAC cloud reaches Jakarta
events.description: Advisory 2026/179: the low-level (FL200) ash cloud now extends over Jakarta and West Java, moving SE at 10 kt. The FL500 cloud keeps moving west at 30 kt.

events.title: Soekarno-Hatta closed
events.description: NOTAM A3341/26 closes CGK from 01:30 WIB. The closure is extended to 05:30, 09:30 and finally 13:30 WIB; 209 movements and about 22,800 passengers affected.

events.title: Further eruption at 03:53 WIB
events.description: Discrete eruption recorded with maximum amplitude 46 mm, duration 30 s.

events.title: BMKG: two ash clusters
events.description: Himawari-9 analysis at 04:00 WIB: cluster 1 (surface to 20,000 ft) over parts of Jakarta, Bogor, Depok, Banten and West Java; cluster 2 (to 50,000 ft) toward Lampung, Bengkulu and the Indian Ocean.

events.title: Ash noticed in Jakarta
events.description: At dawn, residents in South Jakarta and Cilangkap (East Jakarta) find dust on floors, terraces and freshly washed vehicles, and report the air feels heavier.

events.title: Lampung airport closed
events.description: Radin Inten II suspends operations from 07:00 to 10:00 WIB.

events.title: Eruption at 07:10 WIB
events.description: Maximum amplitude 50 mm, duration 16 s. Column height not observed.

events.title: Halim Perdanakusuma closed
events.description: HLP closes at 07:20 WIB (NOTAM A3345/26), estimated reopening 10:00 WIB.

events.title: VAAC: high-level cloud detaches
events.description: Advisory 2026/184: the FL500 cloud is detached from the volcano and moving SW. Continuous emission to FL200 now moves west, while remnants of earlier ash still drift east.
